items.notes: Created handlers with redis restart handler.

items.description: Main task entry point: orchestrates Redis install, myapp deployment, health-check snapshot, schedulerctl registration (⚠️ NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE), and secret fetch (⚠️ NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE). Includes peer-discovery via inventory group as PuppetDB replacement.
items.notes: Converted init.pp to main.yml orchestrating all sub-task files. PuppetDB peer discovery documented as inventory group pattern.

items.description: Install tasks: configure Redis via ansible.builtin modules (bind 0.0.0.0, port 6379, requirepass, maxmemory 2048mb, allkeys-lru, appendonly everysec), ensure /var/log/redis directory exists (owner redis:redis, mode 0755)
items.notes: Cat-4 ordering fixed: log directory creation moved before service start. redis user/group created by package install (task 1) so ownership on log dir task is safe.

items.description: myapp deployment tasks: stat /opt/myapp/version.txt for idempotency, assert URL/version, ansible.builtin.file (directory), get_url to download artifact, unarchive (remote_src), copy version.txt with content '2.1.0'
items.notes: Cat-1 verified: stat on non-existent path is safe (returns exists:false). slurp is guarded. Directory created before download/extract when _myapp_needs_update=true. No fix needed.

items.description: Health-check snapshot tasks: ansible.builtin.uri GET http://localhost:8080/health, ansible.builtin.copy content={{ result.json | to_nice_json }} → /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (owner redis:redis, mode 0644)
items.notes: Cat-2 verified: /var/lib/redis/ is created by redis package which is installed in install.yml before health_check.yml runs. No fix needed.

items.description: ⚠️ NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — schedulerctl registration (query/register --schedule daily redis-node). Developer must obtain schedulerctl CLI spec (exit codes, output format) before implementing ansible.builtin.command tasks with changed_when/failed_when guards.
items.notes: NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — placeholder with detailed developer instructions. schedulerctl CLI is proprietary and undocumented.

items.description: ⚠️ NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — fetches redis_service_token from CompanyInternal::SecretStore (proprietary, undocumented backend). Developer must identify the secrets backend (Vault, AWS, Azure, etc.) before selecting an Ansible lookup plugin or module.
items.notes: NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — placeholder with detailed developer instructions. CompanyInternal::SecretStore backend is unknown. AAP credential injection already provides redis_service_token.

items.description: Redis role fact equivalent: stat /etc/redis/conf.d/replica.conf, slurp/shell to check for 'replicaof' string, register redis_role host variable (primary|replica). Replaces lib/facter/redis_role.rb custom fact.
items.notes: Converted custom Facter fact to Ansible tasks using stat + slurp + set_fact pattern.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Includes role via ansible.builtin.include_role with placeholder credential vars (redis_password, secret_store_url, secret_store_token, redis_service_token) to satisfy validate_credentials.yml. No faked filesystem state.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, valid JSON, owner redis:redis, mode 0644), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), /opt/myapp/ (directory exists), /var/log/redis (exists, owner redis:redis, mode 0755), Redis PING response, health endpoint reachability
items.notes: Two-play verify: Play 1 checks filesystem (redis.conf, /var/log/redis ownership/mode, /opt/myapp dir+version.txt content, health_check.json ownership/mode/valid-JSON). Play 2 checks Redis service running+enabled, port 6379 open, and key redis.conf directives (bind, port, maxmemory, maxmemory-policy, appendonly, appendfsync).
